To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The use of a single, unified provenance model is not practical, (2) The use of multiple models is necessary to support the variety of provenance needs of different communities, (3) A common framework for provenance exchange is required to support the interoperability of these different models, and (4) A provenance framework should be based on an abstract, conceptual model of provenance that is independent of any particular application domain or data representation

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

provenance is about the history, lineage and pedigree of data, information, knowledge and other objects, and that the history, lineage, and pedigree are used for various purposes such as data quality, information quality, data/information quality assurance, data/information integrity, data/information security, and data/information privacy.
the goal of data provenance is to provide a record of the history and the origin of the data, and to enable the user to understand the data and to verify its accuracy.

the provenance of a resource is the information concerning its creation, evolution, source and other properties or characteristics that are or may be considered necessary for an assessment of its quality, authenticity, reliability, or fitness for a purpose.
